slots.jd.school-district.about: Ashgrove Unified School District is seeking a Classroom Teacher to join an on-site elementary team in Ashgrove. The teacher plans and delivers daily instruction, assesses student progress, maintains a safe and orderly classroom, and works with families and colleagues to support each student's learning. The position reports to the building principal and follows district curriculum and policies.
slots.jd.school-district.duties:
Responsibilities of the position
- Plan and deliver daily lessons aligned with district curriculum
- Lead small-group reading instruction based on student assessment results
- Hold parent conferences and keep families informed of student progress
- Take part in team planning with grade-level colleagues and support staff
- Monitor student progress and adjust instruction as needed
slots.jd.school-district.needs:
Qualifications and conditions of employment
- 4 or more years of experience as an elementary classroom teacher
- Demonstrated skill in classroom management and parent communication
- Experience with differentiated instruction and the use of math manipulatives
- Working knowledge of phonics instruction and reading intervention
- Required: a valid Reading Specialist Endorsement issued by the state
- Preferred: Instructional Leadership Endorsement
slots.r1.b1: Adapts reading and math tasks for different learners through Nearpod lessons with tiered questions, raising the share of students completing assigned work by 15 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Tracks student progress through regular checks and uses parent communication to share findings so families know where each child stands.
slots.r1.b3: Builds consistent classroom routines around formative assessment, using quick checks to adjust pacing and cutting time lost to transitions by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Plans daily lessons that use math manipulatives to move students from concrete models to written problems.
slots.r1.i1: Teaches a full class at Hillcrest Elementary School, leading small-group reading sessions matched to each group's current skills.
slots.r1.i2: Leads a classroom at Hillcrest Elementary School with a focus on assessing student progress and using the results to guide instruction.
slots.r2.b1: Led small-group reading using differentiated instruction, grouping students by need and raising the share reading at grade level by 40 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Collaborated with grade-level colleagues in team planning to design behavior supports applied consistently across classrooms.
slots.r2.b3: Prepared for parent conferences with ClassDojo updates on progress and behavior, increasing conference attendance by 15 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Adapted work for different learners while applying classroom management strategies that kept the whole class on task during small-group instruction.
slots.r2.i1: Supported instruction at Willowbrook Elementary School as an Associate Teacher, assessing student progress and sharing results with the lead teaching team.
slots.r2.i2: Worked as an Associate Teacher at Willowbrook Elementary School, planning lessons and units in a team with grade-level colleagues.
slots.summary.1: Elementary classroom teacher with about 4 years of experience running a full class without close supervision. Uses Nearpod, behavior supports and math manipulatives to keep lessons active and students on track.
slots.summary.2: Elementary teaching professional with 4 years of experience who carries a full class independently, from planning to assessment. Combines Nearpod lessons, math manipulatives and consistent behavior supports to meet varied student needs.
